ruleDefinitions.name: Potential RjvPlatform.DLL Sideloading From Default Location
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects loading of "RjvPlatform.dll" by the "SystemResetPlatform.exe" binary which can be abused as a method of DLL side loading since the "$SysReset" directory isn't created by default. Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded
